demand.meaning: Confirmed Demand proxy screening strength, not measured purchases, statistical confidence or forecast revenue.
demand.unknown: Not confirmed Yolk; preserve reason/evidence state.

supply.thresholdMeaning: Gap reference: equal observed rate gives gap score50/100. Lower observed Supply gives a larger gap. Retained High/Low diagnostics remain historical; the primary UI does not use a many/few gate. Never capacity, sales or active Yolk eligibility.
supply.unknown: Missing/nonpositive denominator or unresolved numerator; not zero.
supply.interval: Retain lower/upper and admissible joint constraints; do not render a bound as an exact value.
supply.calibration: Retained per-role national positive exact-count median withN>=5; preserve existing saved contexts and no reseeding while dragging.
supply.countEffect: NONE on confirmed Demand count and active eligible IDs

ranking.uncertainty: Retain rankLower/rankUpper and conservative admissible joint bounds, configured missing weights and evidence coverage.
ranking.zeroWeights: All-zero top weights are invalid; a zero metric weight removes rank contribution but not Demand threshold membership.

our.colorRole: Retained LDS categorical own-network ink; blue

competitor.colorRole: Retained LDS categorical competitor ink; red

unresolved.meaning: Unresolved record; UNKNOWN is not unbranded.

symbols.rule: Symbol identifies party; number or paired bar identifies quantity. More swords does not imply an unattractive location.
symbols.iconsSource: Verified LDS Material Symbols runtime through shared uiIcon helper, never emoji as the shipped symbol.
symbols.pairedBars: Our and competitor use the same metric, denominator, period, unit and local extent within each pair. Set extent to the maximum positive roleUpper, including uncertainty bounds; use fallback1 only when both sides are zero or unavailable. Do not floor positive sub-one rates to1. Label Local scale and actual extent in full/compact views. Do not compare bar lengths across locations. Unknown is labelled; known zero is shown as0. Count mode shows actual branch counts; rate mode shows inventory per named denominator unit.
symbols.poi: Keep actual verified square brand graphic and visible brand name; add party badge. Generic role icon only when an approved graphic is unavailable.

patterns.retained: Historical8definitions/evidence and internal diagnostics may remain for migration; no hidden preferred-pattern membership gate.
patterns.migration: Preserve stored criteria/history; ignore legacy patterns and demandMode for active 1.8 eligibility, mark engineVersion and explain result-set change. Do not emit team-change events merely on load.

map.finePoiRole: Actual branded POIs only at fine-area detail; aggregate symbols never pretend to be point locations.
map.tierColors: Retained owner fried-egg categories; no fill opacity transformation
map.rawMetricColors: All41exact LDS LUT colors identical both themes; scale selected by metric/denominator; review and zero distinct.
